extName.description: Extension name in the store and browser

extDescription.message: Modify request and response headers per profile. Import your ModHeader profiles. Runs locally, sends nothing anywhere.

openInTabTitle.message: The same editor in a browser tab, with more room

needsAccess.message: Headerwise needs access to sites to change their headers.

noAccessHere.message: Headerwise has no access to this site, so nothing is changed here.

cantChangeThisPage.message: Browsers don't let extensions change headers on this page.

noMatchedRulesApi.message: This browser doesn't tell extensions which rules matched, so this is based on the page address.

matchedRulesError.message: Chrome can't say right now which rules matched here ({error}).

line_excluded.message: skipped here: never on {pattern} matches this page

line_notIncluded.message: only on {patterns}: this page doesn't match (its requests to other sites still can)

line_waiting.message: nothing changed here since your last edit: reload the tab

line_narrowed.message: only {scope}: none here since your last edit

profileTabTitle.message: {title}. Drag (or Alt+←/→) to reorder: the leftmost profile wins when two set the same header

timerSelectTitle.message: Switch this profile on, and off again after a while

onlyThisTabButtonTitle.message: Apply this profile only in the current tab, until it closes

duplicateTitle.message: Copy this profile (the copy starts switched off)

headerAction.message: What to do with the header

secretOnTitle.message: Secret: value hidden. Click to show it always

secretOffTitle.message: Mark as secret: hide the value

startHere.message: Start here: type a header name and value above, paste a request copied in DevTools, or pick a preset.

secretsEverywhere_one.message: {names} goes to every site your pages talk to, third-party scripts and fonts included.

secretsEverywhere_other.message: {names} go to every site your pages talk to, third-party scripts and fonts included.

addOnlyOnFilter.message: Add an "only on" filter below to keep them to your own sites.

presetTitle.message: Add a ready-made set of headers

variablesHint.message: Variables: {list}. Chrome sends fixed values, so Headerwise fills them in on every edit and once a minute: requests within that minute share one value.

pastePlaceholder.message: In DevTools → Network, right-click a request → Copy as cURL, fetch or PowerShell, and paste it here. Plain "Name: value" lines work too.

pasteNoHeaders.message: No headers found in that text.

pasteOnlyHost.message: make this profile apply only on {host}

redirectFrom.message: Replace this part of the address

redirectFromPlaceholder.message: part of the URL, e.g. api.example.com

redirectsHint.message: Replaces the first match in the address of a request and sends it there. A new redirect switches on once both fields are filled; to cut text out, leave the second empty and tick it yourself. "Only on" filters don't apply to redirects; "never on" and the other limits do.

scopeHint.message: Nothing ticked means all. "From sites" is the page that made the request: a page opened from the address bar or a bookmark has none, so it doesn't count.

preset_iframe.message: Allow the site in an iframe

moveFromModHeader.message: Move from ModHeader (turned off in Chrome)

importPlaceholder.message: …or paste a share link, or an export from Headerwise, ModHeader, Requestly or Simple Modify Headers

includeSecrets.message: Include secret values (tokens, cookies). Only for your own machines.

rateIt.message: Rate it in the Chrome Web Store

footerLocal.message: Runs locally. No account, no analytics, nothing is sent anywhere.

diagnosticsCopied.message: Copied. Warnings are included as they are: check them before posting.

m_pasteWin.message: In the folder picker, paste it into the address bar at the top and press Enter.

m_pasteMac.message: In the folder picker, press ⌘ Shift G, paste it and press Enter.

m_pasteLinux.message: In the folder picker, press Ctrl+L, paste it and press Enter.

m_someUnreadable.message: Some files in the folder could not be read, so these may not be your latest profiles: {errors}

m_cantReadFiles.message: Could not read ModHeader's files: {errors}. Copy the folder somewhere else and pick the copy, or close the browser that uses it and try again.

m_noProfiles.message: No ModHeader profiles in that folder. Check the path below, or try the same path with "Sync Extension Settings" instead of "Local Extension Settings".

m_stepAccess.message: Let Headerwise change headers on sites. Chrome applies the changes itself; Headerwise never reads your pages.

m_stepPin.message: Pin the icon: click the puzzle piece in the toolbar, then the pin next to Headerwise. Click the icon to add headers.

m_intro.message: Chrome and Edge turned ModHeader off in July 2026, so its Export button is gone. Your profiles are still in its folder on your disk. Headerwise reads them right here, in this page. Nothing is uploaded or sent anywhere.

m_addedHint.message: Click the Headerwise icon in the toolbar to see them. Once you are happy, you can remove ModHeader from the extensions page.

m_step1.message: 1. Copy the path to ModHeader's folder

m_firefoxHint.message: This reads ModHeader's folder from Chrome or Edge on this computer. If you used ModHeader in Firefox and it still opens, use its Export button and "Import JSON" in the Headerwise popup instead.

m_profilesHint.message: If you use several browser profiles, ModHeader may be in another one: open {version} in the profile where you used it and replace {path} with its "Profile Path".

m_uploadHint.message: The browser will ask whether to "upload" the files to this page: that only lets Headerwise read them here.

m_orDrag.message: or drag the folder onto this page

m_tokensHint.message: Profiles often hold tokens and cookies. They stay in this browser only.

w_requestHeader.description: Start of a warning, filled into {where}

w_responseHeader.description: Start of a warning, filled into {where}

w_lineBreak.message: {where}: value contains a line break, skipped.

w_unknownVariable.message: {where}: {variables} is not a Headerwise variable, sent as plain text.

w_cantAppend.message: {where}: Chrome can't append to this request header, use "{set}" instead. Skipped.
w_cantAppend.description: {set} is the name of the 'set' action in the popup

w_redirect.description: Start of a warning, filled into {where}

w_tooManyGroups.message: {where}: too many groups in the pattern (Chrome allows 7), skipped.

w_redirectLoop.message: {where}: the new address would match again and redirect in a loop, skipped.

w_notASiteOnlyFrom.message: "{profile}": "{entry}" in "only from sites" is not a site like example.com, so this profile is off.

w_notASiteNeverFrom.message: "{profile}": "{entry}" in "never from sites" is not a site like example.com, so this profile is off.

w_neverOnUnusable.message: "{profile}": "never on" pattern "{pattern}" is not something Chrome can use, so this profile is off.

w_onlyOnUnusable.message: "{profile}": "only on" pattern "{pattern}" is not something Chrome can use, skipped.

w_noOnlyOnUsable.message: "{profile}": none of its "only on" patterns can be used, so this profile is off.

w_neverOnWins.message: "{profile}" has "never on" patterns, so "{other}" wins on header "{header}" even though it is lower in the list.

w_neverOnAlsoOff.message: "{profile}": its "never on" patterns also turn off "{other}" on matching URLs.

w_noWebSocketRedirect.message: "{profile}": Chrome can't redirect WebSocket requests, redirects skipped.

w_neverOnRegex.message: "{profile}": "never on" regex "{regex}" is not supported by Chrome{why}, so this profile is off.
w_neverOnRegex.description: {why} is empty or Chrome's own reason in brackets, with a space before it

w_onlyOnRegex.message: "{profile}": "only on" regex "{regex}" is not supported by Chrome{why}, skipped.

w_redirectRegex.message: "{profile}": redirect pattern "{regex}" is not supported by Chrome{why}, skipped.

w_tooManyRules.message: Too many rules ({n}), Chrome allows {max}. Only the first {max} are applied.

w_tooManyRegex.message: Too many regex filters ({n}), Chrome allows {max}.

w_noSuchType.message: A rule only for {types} requests was skipped: this browser doesn't have that request type.

w_refused_one.message: The browser refused the rules of {profiles}, so that profile is off.

w_refused_other.message: The browser refused the rules of {profiles}, so those profiles are off.

w_noAccess.message: Headerwise has no access to sites yet, so no headers are changed. Click "{button}" above.
w_noAccess.description: {button} is the text of the 'Allow on all sites' button

w_couldNotApply.message: Headerwise could not apply your profiles: {error}

imp_untitled.description: Name of an imported profile that had none

imp_cookiesAppended.message: "{profile}": request cookies are added to the Cookie header, so a cookie the site set with the same name is still sent too.

imp_cookiesSkipped_one.message: "{profile}": {n} cookie rule matching names by regex or removing a cookie skipped: headers can't express that.

imp_cookiesSkipped_other.message: "{profile}": {n} cookie rules matching names by regex or removing a cookie skipped: headers can't express that.

imp_setInstead_one.message: "{profile}": Chrome can't append to {names}, so it is set instead.

imp_setInstead_other.message: "{profile}": Chrome can't append to {names}, so they are set instead.

imp_unknownTypes.message: "{profile}": resource types {types} are not supported, the rest is kept.

imp_skipped.message: "{profile}": skipped {what}. Headerwise can't do these yet.
imp_skipped.description: {what} is a list of ModHeader features: CSP rules, tab filters...

imp_importedOff.message: "{profile}" is imported switched off: without those filters it would apply to more requests than in ModHeader.

imp_unknownVariable.message: "{profile}": {variables} is not a Headerwise variable and will be sent as plain text.

imp_noProfiles.message: No profiles found in the file.

imp_shareLink.message: This is a ModHeader share link. Open it, export the profile as JSON and paste or pick that file instead.

imp_notModHeader.message: Unexpected format: expected a ModHeader profile export.

imp_badMatchPattern.message: "{pattern}" in the page list isn't a match pattern Headerwise can read.

imp_smhCookies_one.message: {n} cookie row skipped: Simple Modify Headers can only do those in Firefox.

imp_smhCookies_other.message: {n} cookie rows skipped: Simple Modify Headers can only do those in Firefox.

imp_smhBoth.message: "{profile}": it applied only where the page list and "URL contains" both match. Headerwise can't say "both", so it is imported switched off with the "URL contains" patterns; check its filters.
imp_smhBoth.description: 'page list' and 'URL contains' are fields of the Simple Modify Headers extension

imp_smhSiteLost.message: Profiles are imported switched off: part of the page list could not be read, and without it they would apply more widely.

imp_noHeaders.message: No headers found in the file.

imp_fileRedirectsSkipped_one.message: "{profile}": {n} redirect to a local file or mock skipped: Headerwise can only send requests to another URL.

imp_fileRedirectsSkipped_other.message: "{profile}": {n} redirects to a local file or mock skipped: Headerwise can only send requests to another URL.

imp_replacementsSkipped_one.message: "{profile}": {n} replacement skipped: Headerwise can only send requests to another URL.

imp_replacementsSkipped_other.message: "{profile}": {n} replacements skipped: Headerwise can only send requests to another URL.

imp_requestlyNarrowed.message: "{profile}": Requestly replaced the text only on URLs matching its condition; Headerwise replaces it wherever it appears, so this rule comes in switched off. Check it before switching it on.

imp_narrowingLost.message: "{profile}": {what} can't be imported, so this rule comes in switched off.
imp_narrowingLost.description: {what} is a list such as: method TRACE, page URL filter

imp_initiatorOrigin.message: "{profile}": {name} uses Requestly's rq_request_initiator_origin(), which Headerwise sends as plain text.

imp_requestlyOther.message: Skipped Requestly rules that aren't about headers: {list}.
imp_requestlyOther.description: {list} is like: 2 Script, 1 Delay (Requestly's own rule names)

imp_noHeaderRules.message: No header rules found in the file.

imp_newerVersion.message: This file is from a newer Headerwise (format version {version}); some settings may be missing.

imp_secretsEmptied.message: Secret values were not in the file, so these headers are switched off until you fill them in: {headers}.

copyLink.description: Button in the export panel: copies a share link

copyLinkTitle.message: A link with the chosen profiles, for a teammate. Secret values are left out. The profiles travel inside the link, not through a server.

linkCopied.message: Link copied. Secret values are left out, and whoever opens it gets the profiles switched off.

shareLinkBroken.message: This share link is damaged or cut off. Ask for it again, or for an exported file.

sharedOff.message: Profiles from a link come in switched off: check their headers and redirects, then switch them on.

shareTitle.message: A link with this profile for a teammate, secret values left out

shareTooBig.message: These profiles are too big for a link. Use Download and send the file instead.
